prerequisites: Knowledge from basic subjects of mechanical engineering

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge about the fundamentals and relationships of business processes
Assessment of business decision-making processes of companies
Insight into organization and decision-making paths
Demonstrate, carry out and interpret work steps in cost accounting and investment decisions
Evaluate health hazards at the workplace
Recognize the challenges of ergonomics in human-centered production

syllabus_topics: Business organization as structural and process organization, project organization
Operational functional areas, leadership and personnel
Ergonomics, design of workplaces and work processes
teaching_methods: Internship in the form of a business game
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded for a successfully passed written exam. Successful participation in the internship is a prerequisite for taking the exam.
